landing.faq.free.question: Is Fyendal free to play?
landing.faq.free.answer: Yes. Fyendal is a free, open-source, non-commercial community project.
landing.faq.download.question: Do I need to download anything?
landing.faq.download.answer: No. Fyendal runs in a modern web browser, so there is nothing to install.
landing.faq.offline.question: Can I play offline?
landing.faq.offline.answer: No. The hosted game requires an internet connection because matches and hidden information are managed securely by the server.
landing.faq.official.question: Is this an official Flesh & Blood platform?
landing.faq.official.answer: No. Fyendal is a fan-made project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Legend Story Studios. For authoritative rulings, use the official rules or ask a judge.
landing.faq.support.question: What if I find a bug or have a suggestion?
landing.faq.support.answer: Use the bug button during a game to send a report with useful match context. For suggestions or general feedback, join the <discord>Fyendal Discord</discord>.
landing.faq.inPerson.question: Where can I play in person?
landing.faq.inPerson.answer: Use the official <events>Flesh and Blood event locator</events> to find Armory events, local game stores, and other organized play near you.
landing.faq.contribute.question: How can I become a contributor?
landing.faq.contribute.answer: Fyendal is open source. Explore the <github>GitHub repository</github>, then join the <discord>Fyendal Discord</discord> to discuss where you would like to help.
